method: One warmup, randomized engine interleaving, warm filesystem cache, four Rayon threads. Internal execution timing excludes startup, source reading, parsing, binding/type checking, serialization and publication; preparation and output costs reported separately. Complete tables and semantic/work summaries must match on every run. Fused evaluation/aggregation measured together, not attributed artificially to separate phases.

strategies.reference: reference interpreter (requested); direct record iteration=false; unit.id materialized=true; stable top-k=false
strategies.auto: fused filter/derive/aggregate; Truth slots; sparse typed aggregation; direct record iteration=true; unit.id materialized=false; stable top-k=false

predicate_effects.overlaps_and_end_in: extent-sensitive; conservative when omitted geometry is unresolved

semantics.sum_reads_after_where: sum selected units' total accepted observations, not reads satisfying the filter
semantics.support_reads: accepted-observation bounds; unique weights plus each multimapping signature once
semantics.universe: positive retained witness across unique representatives and grouped multimapper alternatives; children are not cropped
semantics.unknown: Kleene logic; omitted ends are not bounded by retained ends
